title: We Are Defenders of Truth!
body:
Dastoor yaa Sayyidee, madad yaa RijaalAllah. (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Laa ilaaha illa-Llah, laa ilaaha illaLlah, laa ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadun Rasoolullah (s). Habeebik, Your beloved friend. Yaa Allah, Ant Allah!
Yaa Allah, Ant Allah! Yaa Allah, Ant Allah! ... Subhaanak! Subhaanak! Laa ilaaha illa-Llah. Allahu akbar,
Allahu akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Madad.
As-salaamu `alaykum attenders of a humble association! But, it is enough to destroy baatil, falsehood! If it
could be ten worlds like our world, it is enough to make baatil down. And enough for rising the flags, holy
flags of Haqq! We are sitting here, for what? We are sitting here to make the flags of heavens go up and up,
finishing baatil, falsehood. We are using flags of Haqq! We are not sitting here to make a show, no. We are
sitting here to make the weakest servant to make flag of truth up! And banderas that belong to Shaytan and
Shaytan's people down, under my feet!!!
O People! Say, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi r-Rahmanir Raheem. The sword of
bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem is enough to make baatil down and to make the heads of supporters of

Shaytan and its followers to be down. O Nation of the Seal of Prophets, (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Sayyidina
Muhammad (s)! Say, bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem, and strike this heavenly sword on their heads and
necks!!! They must be down! There is no time and no chance for them, just finished!!! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah. Shaytan's people are thinking that we are making a show here,
no. That is a heavenly show, not what they are understanding about shows. We are not sitting in a showroom,
or showing for false-road people. Our show is from heavens, now approaching, approaching, approaching.
O followers of Shaytan! First from Muslim countries, beware! Beware, beware, beware! That is a warning first
for Muslim territories, beginning from Saudi Kingdom, going from east to west. Islamic territories must take
their care! That is a warning, that a heavenly sword may take their heads! No one can prevent it, O people!
Dastoor yaa Sayyidee, madad, heavenly support, O Qutb al-Mutasarrif, that you are responsible for
everything that is happening to Mankind.
O Islamic territories! Take your care and beware, because heavenly anger is approaching! Allah Almighty is
never making a show, astaghfirullah, and Allah Almighty is never occupying His Divinely Being with such
things; it is only for one just dressed! Heavenly anger is approaching, as happened before in the time of
Pharoah and Nimrod. Nimrod was so proud with his soldiers and his armies, saying to Abraham, peace be
upon him, "O Abraham, I am coming for fighting your Lord."
The same position now for those no-mind people who are Shaytan's agents, spying for Satan. They are saying,
"Just we finished everything from beliefs and now we are on judgment and just we established from east to
west, from north to south, the government of Shaytan." And those people are under my feet!
Nimrod said to Sayyidina Ibrahim, "I am coming here to fight your Lord! Where are your Lord's armies?"
Sayyidina Ibrahim (a) said, “Tamahhal. Don't be in a hurry. They are approaching. I am not saying they are
armies, no. What they have been ordered from my Lord's creation, the very weakest army is approaching. Be

patient."
And they appeared on the horizon like a black line. And beginning sounds getting louder, louder, louder,
woooohhhhhh, wooooohhhhh, yarta`id, Nimrod's body beginning to tremble. Trembling, approaching that
sound, coming louder, louder, louder. Then Nimrod's armies were beginning trembling. Then just coming,
approaching on them mosquitoes sounding like jet planes, that supersonic sound, whooooooohhhhhh,
whoooooohhhhhh coming!
Nimrod said, "No ilah, no god! I am god on this Earth! I am not accepting anything from your beliefs!"
Why are we not responding to those people? Where are Saudi `ulamas? Where are Egyptian `ulamas? Where
are Salafi `ulamas? Where are Shi`a`ulamas? Why are you not saying anything? Why are you not warning
those Shaytan people who are saying, "There is no god." Why are you teaching that in your schools? They are
trying to make every new generation without beliefs, to say, "There is no god." But nature is falling on their
heads, making them to break. I am angry with them! And they have every possibility to reject whole shaytanic
centers. Why are you not bombarding them, but you are bombarding me?! And you cannot do that, as we are
Defenders of Truth!! We must be Defenders of Truth. Why are you not defending Truth?! And you say you
are doctors? All doctors are going to Jahannam if you are not defending your Lord, and going to Jahannam if
you are not going to speak the truth!!
O People! Beware, the approaching heavenly soldiers. ... Clean the world from east to west, from north to
south. What is necessary, do for them. That is, even the Lord of Heavens is not involving in anything, or the
Seal of Prophets (s). (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Sayyidina Muhammad (s), for whose honor all Creation was
created, is not occupying himself for such things. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)Therefore, he is looking to see which
unknown weakest one can be appointed for bombarding their fortress. I am the weakest one among them and
I am suitable for destroying naturalist people and those who say, "There is no god," and to make their heads
under my feet!!! And I am the weakest one to stop their technology, not within minutes but within seconds,
(and I am) authorized!!

Beware! Fear from Allah Almighty. Beware, you have tajaawuz, gone over your limits. You are in that area
that it is not for you to step on it. Ihfazh haddek, Keep your limit. That is a heavenly order to all nations:
Muslims, Christians, Jewish people and others, atheist people, communist people, and socialist people that
they are on the wrong way. Ihfazh haddak, "Keep your limit!" Ihfazh haddak, O people, keep your position!
Don't disturb the area that is forbidden for you. Keep your feet not to step on that area that is forbidden for
everyone, that belongs to your Lord's heavens. Keep yourself and protect yourselves not to put your feet on
that forbidden area. Forbidden area! Keep your feet! Don't put there! Don't speak! That is not for you!
O scientists, and all people who are claiming, "We know something." You must keep your limit; know your
limit, ihfazh haddak. If not, like the Lord sent mosquitoes, He now may send pig flu on you! (Mawlana
Shaykh laughs.) You heard about pig flu? Scientists now put a mask to protect themselves from pig flu. You
are scientists, why are you putting? Still it may come another time.
Once upon a time, this was coming in Basra, a holy city in Iraq. I am asking forgiveness for the people of Iraq,
and I am warning them also to stop killing! I am warning them also from heavenly orders to stop
troublemakers from Baghdad to holy cities, and also to stop killers, or (heavens will be)sending something
else (on them), as once happened in Basra a plague. A terrible, terrible creature with such a power Allah (swt)
put in those small ones, taa`oon, a toxic substance. You never knew that? He Almighty sent such unknown
creatures that if touching a person in the morning, by evening that one passed away, or if in the evening
touching that person, in the morning passing. And over the city of Basra came a punishing cloud. On the first
day 70,000 people passed away! That is some knowledge coming from real knowing-peoples' knowledge. On
the second day, 71,000 passed away; on the third day, 73,000 passed away; on the fourth day, in that huge
city no one was alive; no one in homes opened their doors to come out, and no one was alive to enter their
homes.
Fear from Allah! O unbelievers, O troublemakers, O naturalist people and atheist people, fear from Allah, or
such things will come! And therefore I am sending a warning to Iraqi people to stop killing and stop being
troublemakers, or coming to you something that you can't use your bombs and you will fall down from
Unseen creatures! That is a warning for them also and to people of the whole world. Beware for heavenly

anger! That is a warning from Sayyidina Muhammad, peace be upon him. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.)
I am not speaking a story; it is reality. They are making me to address people. If you are accepting, you are
saving yourself, if not looking, coming a heavy cursing on Muslim people, Christian people, and Buddhist
people, to be taken away.
Dome, dome, dome, dome
Dome, dome, dome, dome
Dome, dome, dome, dome
Dome, dome, dome, dome
O Nimrods! For this, beware of the Lord's heavenly anger!
Dome, dome, dome, dome
Making your heads under my feet.
Dome, dome, dome, dome
(36 minutes.) That is enough for bombarding.
OK. How many people? (618) (Mawlana Shaykh laughs.)
Shaykh Hisham Effendi? (Mawlana Shaykh speaks on the phone with Shaykh Hisham.)
